puzzle.body: Get rid of reb4j dependency and build that regular expression on compile phase, somehow. Maybe we can use some sort of Groovy plugin, which will create the expression and store it in a plain text file, which will be used later in runtime. It's important to leave expression building mechanims maintainable. If we just hard-code the expression, we'll loose an ability to maintain/change it later.

puzzle.body: Implement XPath 2.0 evaluations. We have to implement XPath 2.0 evaluations in order to support more complex XPath queries. For example, the following query is not supported: - "//o[@base and @ver]/concat(@base,'|',@ver)" When we implement XPath 2.0 evaluations, we should remove the @Disabled annotation from findsXpathWithFunctionThatReturnsSeveralItems test.

puzzle.body: Enable Groovy Integration Test The Groovy integration test is disabled because it fails. The problem is that the XMLDocument#equals method is indentation-aware, but it shouldn't be. We need to fix it and enable the test.

puzzle.body: Implement comparison of XML documents with different indentations. The current implementation of XMLDocument does not ignore different indentations when comparing two XML documents. We need to implement a comparison that ignores different indentations. Don't forget to remove the @Disabled annotation from this test.
